The Weigh Count Sorting table automatically dispenses product into the Rollbag R3200 once the target count has bee reached. The Weigh Count Sorting Table has an accuracy of 0.003 oz (0.1 g) and a max bucket weight of 6.6 lbs (3 kg). Click here for videos and more details on this packaging machine.

occurrences.nearest_text: The Rollbag R3200 Med is a validatable pouching system for automatic packaging. The version of this machine will be designed to work with Tyvek/Poly rollstock with a pre-made chevron bottom seal. The machine will print identifying information on the Tyvek side, perforate and open the bag for loading, apply an 8mm wide top seal, and separate the finisehd pouch. Dry cycle speed estimate is around 15 bags/min. The R3200 Med automates the process of labeling, filling, and sealing medical products that are packaged in Tyvek pouches with a chevron seal and need to be sterilized.
